references.text: Aaron and his sons were chosen to perform the priestly service, confirming that the tribe of Levi was selected to serve the Lord.
Aaron and his sons shall carry out the priestly duties at the altar and before the veil, showing they were chosen to serve in the name of the Lord.
God chose Aaron and his sons from among the children of Israel to serve as priests, which aligns with the selection described in Deuteronomy.
The tribe of Levi was set apart to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord, stand before the Lord, serve him, and bless in his name.
Levitical priests were chosen by the Lord to serve him and to bless in the name of the Lord.
The Lord shows who belongs to him and who is holy, allowing them to come near to himself—this confirms God's choice.
David affirms that no one other than the Levites should carry the ark of God, for the Lord has chosen them to bear the ark and serve him forever.
Every high priest is selected from among people and appointed to serve God on behalf of people, reflecting the principle of divine selection for priestly service.
